sam: FYI noticed a user report: console showed 190 provisional tokens but ledger settled 140. suspect reconnect + toolcall retry double-count.

maya: ugh, can you dump the trace id?

sam: trace=tr_20260322_b7f2. Relevant events: STREAM_CHUNK(80, partial), TOOLCALL(60, truncated,retry), FINAL_SETTLE(140). console sums provisional events and shows 80+60=140 then adds an interim provisional 50? weird.

billing-bot: ALERT: provisional_charge anomaly for customer acme-qa at 2026-03-22T10:05:12Z (tr_20260322_b7f2)

alex: Could be the console aggregator treating truncated toolcalls as additive instead of overlapping. We've had similar cases but not with a routing model-swap mid-session. Any routing logs?

maya: yes, router log shows route change to model-gpu-v2 at 10:04:59 and toolcall TTL triggered fallback. We emitted both STREAM_PART and TOOLCALL_TRUNC events.

toni: console naive algorithm: provisional_total = sum(events.tokens where event.state=='provisional'). No overlap detection.

sam: here's a quick pseudocode we use on the backend for settled totals, maybe copy for provisional:
```
// compute canonical token delta
sort events by timestamp
canonical = 0
for e in events:
  if e.type == 'final_settle': canonical = e.tokens
  else if overlaps_with_previous(e): // overlapping token window
    canonical += dedupe(e)
  else:
    canonical += e.tokens
```
console does no overlaps_with_previous.

alex: Suggestion: two-step mitigation: 1) Console quick fix: when provisional shows > settled_history median, show an explanatory banner and hide per-event rollups by default. 2) Ledger/aggregator emits provisional_canonical and provisional_reason tags (new optional fields). Console will prefer canonical if present.

maya: backend change has ripple effects; dashboards and billing alerts consume provisional totals. We should add the fields but keep old behavior unless customer opt-in.

toni: telemetry: add tag routing_fallback=true and event.meta.previous_prefix_len so we can detect overlap heuristics. Also add metric provisional_vs_canonical.diff.

sam: will prototype provisional_canonical in ledger as opt-in flag (ledger.v2.provisional_canonical=true) and compute using overlap-aware algo. Will emit provisional_reason: "overlap_trim(toolcall_vs_stream)".

alex: I'll push the minimal console banner + hide-rollup change today (low risk). can we coordinate on which accounts we enable opt-in?

maya: enable for acme-qa and two internal test orgs first. CS pinged.

toni: I'll create a Grafana panel: query sessions where provisional_total - provisional_canonical > 0 and group by routing_variant.

sam: shipping plan: opt-in flag behind feature flag, test for 48h, then expand. RFC incoming.

maya: file BI ticket for user confusion and a short CS explainer.

alex: small UX note: include link to raw event stream in the banner so ops can inspect session quickly.

billing-bot: NOTE: ticket BI-6921 created (console_provisional_overlap)

maya: OK thanks team. keeping this thread open for the RFC + rollout notes. :thumbsup:
